consent.policyBody:
We collect the financial information you provide — linked bank data, uploaded statements, transactions, budgets, and goals — plus your chat messages, to build and manage your personalized plan. Generating AI-powered advice sends the relevant parts of this data to OpenAI for processing; your bank login credentials are never included in that. We never sell your data to anyone, for any reason.

Emails (verification, password reset, notifications) are sent via Gmail. You can view or correct most of your data at any time within the app, and delete your account and all of its data permanently from your profile page whenever you choose to.
